LanguageData.CC_Camp_Goodbye: {X_nameDef} sent word at dusk: the {NAME} will soon be on their way. {X_nameDef} thanked the colony for the land and the quiet, and asked whether they'd be welcome this way again.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Goodbye_2: At dusk the {NAME} sent word that they are getting ready to go on. They were glad of the colony's land, {X_nameDef} said, and would like to know whether they could stop here again.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Goodbye_3: Word came over from the {NAME} as the light went: their stay is nearly done. {X_nameDef} asked, for all of them, whether the colony would have them back another time.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Goodbye_Warm: {X_nameDef} sent word as the light went: the {NAME} will soon be on their way. The colony had been better to them than most, {X_nameDef} said, and they'd carry its name down the road. The colony could send them off with {COUNT} meals for the way, or just a word.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Goodbye_Warm_2: Word came from the {NAME} at dusk: they are nearly ready to go on. Few places on the road had treated them so well, {X_nameDef} said, and the colony's name would travel with them. The colony could send them off with {COUNT} meals for the way, or just a word.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Goodbye_Cool: {X_nameDef} sent word that the {NAME} will soon be gone. It was short, and nobody from the camp came to say it. Still, a road goes two ways, and a word now might count later.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Goodbye_Cool_2: The {NAME} let the colony know, briefly, that they are packing to go. {X_nameDef} had nothing more to say than that. A word from the colony now might still count for something on the road.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Goodbye_Again: {X_nameDef} sent word at dusk, as last time: the {NAME} will soon be on their way. They would pass this way again, {X_nameDef} said, if they're wanted.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_Goodbye_Again_2: The {NAME} are getting ready to go on again, and {X_nameDef} sent word at dusk the way {X_pronoun} did before. Would the colony have them back once more?
